subject: prd/implement-now
statement: After discovering non-empty implementation or selected review work, when and only when an `executor.review` block is present, the executor shall determine every distinct effective review backend needed by that frontier—the explicit `review.backend` for new tasks, each task's selected implementation backend when inherited, and each selected persisted obligation's frozen backend—then build its typed factory and authenticate its reviewer service identity exactly once per distinct backend before any implementation dispatch or review attempt. An absent block installs no review seam/preflight. Factory/auth/config failure takes FR-42's run-level `not_created` path for new work and its obligation-scoped `pending` path for selected persisted obligations, spawning no task/reviewer. A persisted obligation never switches backend.
rationale: optional review remains uninstalled by default; invalid setup fails before avoidable task/review spend; recovery cannot erase or switch a frozen backend
fit_criterion: absent-config/combined-empty perform zero build/auth; explicit and mixed inherited new-work fixtures preflight each backend once before task dispatch; pending A plus current B preflights the union without switching A; new-work failure emits one run-level not-created terminal and zero task/pending work; selected-pending failure emits one pending infrastructure terminal per obligation and zero launch
